text:
alex: Quick sync — customer vignettes from AcmeHealth and BeaconOps point to two asks: (1) actionable batch/caching recs per workload, (2) eval-triggered alerting when quantization regressions surface. How do we fold into Optimize toolkit v1?

sasha: +1 on both. From product POV we need a small surface that gives: per-route batching knobs, cache TTL suggestions, and a quantization risk score with recommended fallback. Pilot w/ 2 customers.

lee: For batching recs I think we can ship heuristics: short-completion vs long-stream heuristics + sample-based throughput estimate. 80% of wins with ~5 rules.

tom: Danger: adding rules bloats config. Propose a defaults-first path: opinionated presets (mobile, chat, embeddings) + advanced toggle.

maya: Eval-alerts: we should tie to evaluation suites (prompt sets). When regression > X% across key metrics => create alert + suggested rollback model variant. Also include example diff payloads in alert.

sasha: Agree. Key acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Pilot acceptance w/ AcmeHealth & BeaconOps (end-to-end ingest, recs, alert trigger)
- 50% reduction in per-token cost for targeted workloads via batching/caching heuristics
- Regression detection precision >= 80% on labeled prompt sets
- Playbook doc + runbook for ops on false positives

alex: Who owns the pilot? Sasha to lead product; Lee to own batching heuristics dev; Tom owns config UX; Maya owns eval-alerts + failure cases.

release-bot: :white_check_mark: Release preview env updated for optimize-toolkit/v1 — tag: otk-v1-alpha

sasha: Timeline proposal: 3 sprints to alpha (design + infra + pilot hook), 2 sprints for pilot & fixes, then GA gating. Any objections?

tom: No objections. Need one more infra ticket: prefix caching API and sampling pipeline. I'll open it.

lee: I'll draft heuristics doc and a quick experiment plan (latency vs throughput tradeoffs) by EOD Friday.

alex: Great. I'll summarize in the roadmap doc and loop in customer success for pilot onboarding. Thanks y'all.
